notes.title: Dungeon And Puzzles is a lovely, efficient puzzle game
notes.content:
I admire Dungeon and Puzzles for how efficiently made it is. It's a sokoban puzzle game about fighting through dungeons, and it's made predominantly by one person with art pulled from this $10 sprite tilset. It's also cute and smart and I've been having a grand time playing its first 25 levels.

notes.title: Dev Log #4 - Added Non-linear Map & Updated Store Page & Demo is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello There,

I’m HuMoFish, the developer of “Dungeon and Puzzles”. We had redesigned the level selection scene. From monotonous linear level selection to the adventurous non-linear map! Let’s take a look!


The original level menu is just a simple panel, displaying multiple level buttons at a time, and the next level can only be unlocked after the previous level is cleared. It looks ordinary and unsurprising. Furthermore, if the player can't solve the level, he is not able to play any other levels after it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37391132/73658bdf7f37b0a85b6883e184a22e0d23105448.gif[/img]


We changed the level menu to a dungeon map, extending downward from the castle on the cover. The level is like a room, and when the level is cleared, the surrounding levels will be unlocked. Clear the level with an arrow mark can further unlock new areas. Even more, the map has some secret levels waiting for players to discover.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37391132/9a3b6c6de67cb85ca4cc5ccb4ae72070cc29af12.gif[/img]

We believe that changing to a non-linear map will make players feel more adventurous. You can choose what level you want to solve first. Go deep into the ground along with your play. If you can't pass a certain level, you still could try other levels. The game will not be completely impossible to proceed.


Additionally, we update the whole information on the store page. The demo will be released soon! Please keep following us!

Any ideas or suggestions are welcome!! please let us know!

See you next time!
HuMoFish


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1229060/

notes.title: Dev Log #1 - Welcome to the Dungeon and Puzzles & Progress Report
notes.content:
Hello There,

I’m HuMoFish, the developer of “Dungeon and Puzzles”. This game was originally expected to be released on June 10. However, an artist from Poland has contacted me. He enjoys the gameplay a lot. But he is also pretty honest to point out from an artistic point of view, there are still things that can be improved. After discussing with him, and seeing the mock-up he has done,  I believe it’s worth spending more time to improve the graphics of  “Dungeon and Puzzles”. So I decided to cooperate with him and let him do the magic!!

Therefore, the release date is postponed for better results, once it’s completed, please follow us for more news.


[b][i]With the artist joining me, the visual of the game has been greatly improved. here are some before and after comparison pictures for you guys to have a look:[/i][/b]

1. Removed the floaty feel of rooms. Added decorations like carpet and banner. Added shadow and light effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37391132/705fbcdb0403ac2559e504277bf9ef9e5881d75c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37391132/300236b01b5c5d8a9dbb05f48212d7023cebb533.png[/img]

2. Added new texture tiles like wooden support. Change the stairs to the portal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37391132/99be6f63aeec00f93024cab1991f019eaa79a80c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37391132/a809dfecb4abaf7ddfa18a99c34b7f157e574441.png[/img]

3. Light effect detail.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37391132/be077b95d186e4720222c310a057d323a01e495d.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37391132/346b16eeb3bfbd7ddf2d2832dabc751616761f1e.gif[/img]


In general, the dev log will be posted every two weeks until game development is completed and released. If you are interested, please add “Dungeon and Puzzles” to your wishlist!

See you!
HuMoFish
